orchestkit · ork:glyph 3.0 · 2026-09-17

One render, up to 50 lines, verdict first.

The 2026-08-09 budget (12 visual lines, 40 percent of the reply) fixed a flooding problem and then over-corrected: shape-shaped questions got prose and one thin table. This page shows the before and the after, and the anatomy the skill now draws by default.

01 · before / after

The same question, two budgets

"What is using my disk?" on a 460 G Mac. Left is what the 12-line budget allowed. Right is the v3 reference render: a header meter, three traffic-light sections, rows of icon / label / bar / value / action, a total per section, one arithmetic summary line, and caveat lines for the numbers that lie.

before · 12-line budget · 8 lines

Disk is 83 % full. About 87 G is reclaimable.

cache entries; Docker's own accounting says 14.5 G reclaimable.
The iOS simulators are real work, not cruft: a device booted yesterday.
Two things look like caches but are payloads: the Claude VM image and
the Whisper models. Both kept out of "safe".

Hover a part on the right to see which slot of the anatomy it fills. The "before" is not a straw man: it is what the old rule produced when followed to the letter, and it is the reply the operator called "we do not use it enough".

02 · anatomy

Eight parts, drawn top to bottom

The skill drops a part only when the data has nothing for it. Everything else is fixed, including the column starts (icon 0, label 3, bar 39, value 48, action 56), so rows from different replies line up the same way.

#PartWhat it carries
0Verdict lineOne prose sentence before the render. If the reader has to parse the chart to learn the verdict, the reply failed.
1HeaderOne domain icon, the subject, ·, the path or scope.
2Headline meter[▓▓▓░░] with the numbers printed on the line under it.
3SectionA light rule and a traffic-light word: 🟢 SAFE, 🟡 REGENERABLE, 🔴 ASK FIRST, or the domain's own words.
4Rowsicon · label · bar ▓▓▓░░ · value · one-word action. One domain icon per row, leading column.
5Section total── 45.3 G, right-aligned under the values, one per section.
6Summary lineShows the arithmetic with +, ≈, →, so the reader can check it.
7Caveat linesℹ️ per number that lies. ? for a number you do not have, never a guess.
8What the numbers told meTwo or three bold-led bullets after the render, on what is not obvious from the chart.
03 · budget

Where the line moved

The 12-line ceiling was measured against a 151-reply sample (block p90 = 13 lines). It bound the tail, and then bound everything else too. Rule 2 (verdict first) is what actually prevented the 2026-08-09 flood, so it stays; the line budget rises to about 50 and the render count is fixed at one.

old
12 lines · 40 %
new
~50 lines · 76 cells · 1 render

Under both budgets: fine.

04 · vocabulary

Status set closed, domain icons added

Status icons stay a closed set and each pairs with a word; the only addition is ℹ️ caveat. Domain icons are new: one per row, leading column, never inside a prose sentence. They live in the skill's tokens.json under icons.domain; add there, not ad hoc.

🐳 docker🌐 browser📦 package🐍 python 🧠 model📱 device💾 volume🗑️ trash 🗂️ files📥 downloads🔑 secret🧪 test 🖥️ host☁️ cloud📧 mail💬 chat
